title: OpenText World 2026: Big ideas, concrete answers
summary: Join us at OpenText World 2026 for tracks and sessions designed to inform and inspire attendees about the latest technology trends.
body_markdown:
Join us at OpenText World 2026 to get your questions answered, gain new perspectives, and explore what’s possible. Imagine getting that much done in just three days!


Whether you’re a technical doer putting OpenText™ products to work, a decision maker turning strategy into action, or an executive deciding where your enterprise goes next, OpenText World 2026 will give you the information and inspiration you need to improve your organization.


## **Tracks and sessions**


This year’s event in Orlando, October 19–22, features seven tracks designed to answer questions about “How do I…?” These tracks include:


- The AI-ready enterprise: Modernize content, maximize impact
- Protect your OpenText data in the AI era: Govern and control agentic AI
- Transition to proactive IT operations
- From data chaos into autonomous operations
- Win the relationship: Experience architecture for the retention economy
- Running OpenText at scale: Stability, performance, outcomes
- Autonomous software delivery: Move fast and trust every release


Each track contains[dozens of sessions](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?environment=P2) ranging from strategic roundtables to product roadmap reviews to hands-on coding meetups, so you can walk away ready to put what you’ve learned into practice.


To see how much you can accomplish at OpenText World, here’s what a single day could look like:


- Move beyond basic extensions and learn how to embed true intelligence into your enterprise content repository. ([AI Lab | How to build AI agents for OpenText Content Management](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=2753ccb1-dc73-436c-b33e-8edd95e5a67a&shareLink=true) , Tuesday, 11 a.m.)
- Connect with professionals in the public sector to compare notes around best practices and lessons learned in an informal setting. ([Public sector industry client connect](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=44cf224c-5453-41a8-bb27-ce750602ed3e&shareLink=true) , Tuesday, 12:30 p.m.)
- Hear directly from an IT director at a leading high-tech company about how OpenText Managed Services transformed a manual invoicing process into an automated powerhouse, driving $4 billion in annual revenue. ([Overcoming integration complexity: Inside one high-tech company’s journey to a $4B automated revenue ecosystem](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=a96d11d5-8961-46b2-abdf-cac136078c26&shareLink=true) , Tuesday, 1 p.m.)
- Drop in for a candid conversation with OpenText’s AI practitioners. Bring a use case, a challenge, or just curiosity, and walk away with answers and clear next steps. ([AI office hours: Bring your toughest questions to a forward deployed engineer](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=3bd5f8c2-bca9-4251-9a54-a0d626a32636&shareLink=true) , Tuesday, 2:45 p.m.)
- Learn from an expert how to drive meaningful user adoption by embedding change management into every stage of your project—not as an afterthought, but as a core strategy. ([From rollout to results: Boosting user adoption in information management implementations to maximize success](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=231bf795-b539-4d1d-957f-580f4bd65eb9&shareLink=true) , Tuesday, 4 p.m.)


## **Navigating the online session catalog**


The online session catalog makes it easy to build a personalized conference experience. Each entry includes a title, session type, description, which track it’s relevant to, and which attendee role the session is tailored for. Share buttons let you send catalog entry links to colleagues, and you can also build your own agenda on the site then share that. You can also filter by track, industry, role, area of interest, and category.


If you haven’t yet, register and[start building your personalized agenda today](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?shareLink=true) . And check back often to see what we’ve added.
